messages:
oliver (partnerships): Thought experiment: what if we offer a staged entitlement marketplace flow: start with a 3-month committed tile that auto-unlocks a private-offer conversion window + partner co-sell credit if they convert to an annual SKU within 45 days of invoice?
meera (acct): That could lower friction for customers who want predictability but not a full-year commitment. Would help our renewals motion.
carlos (revops): We need to model billing implications. If tile is billed as committed months then conversion generates a prorated credit and a private-offer order. We must avoid double-billing during the switch.
lina (legal): Legal note: private-offer conversion needs explicit acceptance. Also partner crediting must be defined in the PO terms so marketplace policy + partner contract don't conflict. Single-use conversion token recommended.
patrick (cloud-partner): From partner POV: co-sell credit is attractive if we get attribution on the marketplace order. Can we attach partner_id in the private-offer metadata so our tracking can be automatic?
oliver (partnerships): Yes. Implementation sketch for listings team: list 3 SKUs: commit.tile.3m, commit.tile.6m, commit.tile.convertable. Each convertible SKU contains metadata fields: conversion_window_days=45, partner_id, conversion_rebate_pct, conversion_flow_url.
meera (acct): Customer-facing line: "Start smaller, lock pricing — convert to annual within 45 days to receive a conversion credit and partner incentives." Short + clear.
carlos (revops): Revops checklist: (1) conversion creates PR for negative invoice line (credit), (2) new annual invoice issues, (3) reconciliation to partner ledger for co-sell via partner_id. Need 2-week lead time for billing changes.
lina (legal): Approvals: (A) standard private-offer language appended; (B) a checkbox on the marketplace checkout confirming conversion terms; (C) cap rebates at configurable threshold per account size.
marketplace-bot: FYI: changes to listing schema require a 7-day review and marketplace policy review.
patrick (cloud-partner): Quick ask: if we run a pilot, can partners get co-sell credit within 72 hours of conversion? faster attribution helps our ops.
oliver (partnerships): Pilot plan: 30 accounts across mid-market + ISV-lift. KPIs: conversion rate within 45d, incremental ARR from conversions, partner-attributed deals, and rebate impact. I'll draft tracking sheet + pilot brief.
carlos (revops): I'll run financial sims with 10/25/40% conversion scenarios and share by EOD Friday.
meera (acct): I'll pick pilot accounts and prepare outreach messaging.
oliver (partnerships): Thanks all — I'll post the pilot doc + proposed SKU payloads in the partnerships folder. Ping me for reviews :wave:
